name: Dual Number Automatic Differentiation for Scalar Fields
aliases: Exact Normals via Forward Automatic Differentiation
definition: Computes the gradient of a scalar field at a point using forward-mode automatic differentiation by evaluating the field on dual numbers representing coordinate perturbations.
summary: Dual Number Automatic Differentiation computes exact scalar field gradients via forward-mode propagation, avoiding finite difference errors and eliminating the need to store computation graphs.
